data.narrative:
Galadyne, a pre-seed stage defense and security company founded by Chandler Luzsicza, has raised $4.8M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 10 private frontier-tech firms in Defense & Security (including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic) alongside 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS).

Only one valuation method proved applicable. The Stage-Progression approach uses Galadyne's $4.8M total raised as a proxy valuation floor, then applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for Pre-Seed to next-stage advancement, yielding $12M. The Peer-Median method was not executable: while 26 same-sector peers exist, filtering for stage-aligned and tier-similar companies returned insufficient datapoints (fewer than 3 required for statistical reliability), making broad-sector median figures misleading rather than informative.

The triangulated valuation range is $10M (low) to $14M (high), centered at $12M. This reflects a narrow analytic foundation—derived from a single applicable method with limited peer-comparable depth in the pre-seed Defense & Security space. Key uncertainties include the absence of stage-matched comparables, reliance on a raised-capital proxy in lieu of revenue or operational metrics, and the volatility inherent to pre-seed stage risk. A fuller valuation would require either additional pre-seed Defense & Security data or progression to a stage where revenue or customer-traction benchmarks become available.
